_metadata.description: P1 natural language query requirements for Lifestyle Dashboard

requirements.title: Natural language query parsing
requirements.description: Parse natural language questions into structured queries using Ollama. Support questions like 'How has my sleep been this month?' and 'What changed when I started creatine?'

requirements.title: Natural language query execution
requirements.description: Execute parsed queries against event data and format results as human-readable responses with relevant charts/summaries
